_about: Every board Outrigger builds for, one profile each (docs/boards.md, 'Adding a board'). tools/boards.py checks this file and generates from it: the Makefile's board list and FQBN, each build's board_config.h (the pins firmware/waveshare_169/board.cpp drives), the screens make ui-shots renders, and the installer's board list (tools/build_site.py, docs/site-redesign/build.py). Pins: a GPIO number, 'exioN' for pin N of the I/O expander, or null for none. hold_low and hold_high: pins wired to something Outrigger doesn't use that would make noise floating (hold_why says what). tested: someone has run Outrigger on one; the installer and docs say 'untested' until then. tag_id goes in the build tag so the installer can tell which board a build is for; 0 is the 1.69, as builds from before the field say.

waveshare_169.name: Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-LCD-1.69
waveshare_169.usb_host: The one USB-C port, wired straight to GPIO19/20 (Waveshare's wiki: 'ESP32-S3 USB port').
waveshare_169.hold_why: GPIO42 drives the onboard buzzer (Waveshare's pin map: 'Buzz'); floating, it picks up nearby traffic and ticks. First-revision boards wired the buzzer to GPIO33, an octal-PSRAM line: no firmware fix for those.

waveshare_35.name: Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-LCD-3.5
waveshare_35.usb_host: The one USB-C port, wired straight to GPIO19/20 through 22-ohm resistors; no converter chip (V1 and V2 schematics).
waveshare_35.hold_why: EXIO7 enables the NS4150B speaker amplifier (PA_CTRL). There is no buzzer. The expander powers up with its pins as inputs pulled high, which would leave the amplifier on.
waveshare_35.source: Waveshare's ESP32-S3-Touch-LCD-3.5 repo: V1 and V2 schematics (same pins for everything here) and examples/arduino 08_gfx_helloworld, 11_lvgl_arduino_v8

freenove_28.name: Freenove ESP32-S3 Display 2.8" (FNK0104B)
freenove_28.usb_host: The one USB-C port, wired straight to GPIO19/20 through 0-ohm resistors; no converter chip (Freenove's 2.8-inch schematic). VBUS powers the board through a Schottky diode.
freenove_28.hold_why: GPIO1 (AUDIO_EN) is the SC8002B speaker amplifier's SHUTDOWN pin: high is off. A 10k pull-up already keeps it off; the profile holds it high so nothing else can switch it on. No buzzer.
freenove_28.source: Freenove/Freenove_ESP32_S3_Display: Schematic/2.8inch_ESP32-S3_Display_Schematic.pdf, Libraries/FNK0104AB TFT_eSPI setup FNK0104AB_2.8_240x320_ILI9341.h (BGR, inversion on, 40 MHz), touch sketches (FT6336U on SDA 16, SCL 15, RST 18, INT 17). Cross-checked with konsumer/fm1buddy's cyd-s3 env (esp32-s3-devkitc1-n16r8: 16 MB flash, 8 MB octal PSRAM).
